opportunity_name: Merchant sulphuric acid for ISR mines
investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: acid producer/infrastructure partner builds sulphur-burning plant, storage and tank cars near southern ISR mines.
buyer_market: Kazatomprom ISR JVs; optional fertiliser sales are not bankable demand.
why_now: FACT: TQZ is financed but delayed to Q3 2027-Q1 2028 (S01-S02); shortage does not establish a long-lived merchant gap.
strongest_realistic_alternative: TQZ/captive acid plus existing and future smelter acid, rather than a foreign greenfield plant.
deciding_location_factor: Delivered acid cost and contracted mine demand after competing capacity ramps.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: Turkestan/Kyzylorda proximity reduces hazardous freight; does not beat captive/by-product supply automatically.
scale_view: Large anchor industry; residual uncontracted tonnes over a plant repayment period UNKNOWN.
physical_constraint_view: Sulphur price/allocation, water, rail sidings, tank cars and site utilities UNKNOWN.
captured_status: FACT: competing TQZ financing exists. No evidence that all future demand or a new merchant slot is captured.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: contracted supply margin plus lower transport/interruption costs; no scarcity premium assumed permanent.
cheapest_kill_test: Does southern uncontracted demand remain after TQZ and smelter acid?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S01 finances 800 kt/yr TQZ; S02 issuer update postpones start by 6-12 months and expects no material mining effect at that stage.
key_unknown: Residual contractable demand when a NEW merchant plant could start.
next_test_if_uwt: 45-min desk test: dated 2027-2034 southern acid balance by mine and competing plant, distinguishing committed volumes; validate residual with KAP procurement when available.
pass_condition_if_uwt: Uncommitted demand persists beyond own start-up and supports vendor minimum scale at delivered cost below mines' next-best supply.
kill_or_park_condition_if_uwt: FAIL if committed supply demonstrably covers all reachable demand through repayment; PARK if only a short bridge gap survives.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: a delay cannot fund a long-life plant by itself; mine-linked logistics remains plausible, so test the residual balance rather than FAIL.

investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: mining-chemicals strategic builds CS2/xanthate production and mine-service capacity at Pavlodar or Jibek Joly.
buyer_market: Kazakh/Uzbek/Kyrgyz copper, gold and polymetallic concentrators.
why_now: FACT: first stage of Almalyk concentrator launched 16 March 2026 with 60 Mt/yr design (S04); smelter tonnes are not reagent demand.
strongest_realistic_alternative: Zhongtian Chemical in Tashkent region plus Chinese reagent imports; final strongest delivered offer UNKNOWN.
deciding_location_factor: Qualified reagent cost per tonne of ore, secure volumes and on-mine performance.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: local service/lead time could help Kazakh mines; Uzbek production removes a unique regional-proximity claim.
scale_view: S03 states first-phase 10 kt/yr xanthate design. Accessible incremental purchases UNKNOWN; broad HS 293090 is not a valid xanthate market.
physical_constraint_view: CS2 hazards, alcohol/alkali/carbon inputs, process permits, water and site power unconfirmed.
captured_status: FACT: regional producer offers reagents and testing; its stated line capacity is not verified utilisation or total capture.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: reagent margin and technical-service value versus imported procurement.
cheapest_kill_test: Is enough qualified demand left after Uzbek/Chinese supply at a competitive delivered price?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S03 names CS2/xanthate lines and ore-testing laboratory; S04 confirms first-stage launch, not full-capacity utilisation; S36 identifies a narrower xanthate classification lead.
key_unknown: Mine-specific doses, uncontracted procurement and competitive delivered prices.
next_test_if_uwt: 60-min desk test: named-mine reagent tender quantities/specifications, HS293010 classification/current-version check and 2023-2025 trade cross-check; compare China and Zhongtian delivered offers to one Kazakh site.
pass_condition_if_uwt: Accessible annual tonnes meet quoted minimum plant scale and qualified cost/ore tonne beats best delivered offer.
kill_or_park_condition_if_uwt: FAIL if tender/contract evidence rules out viable reachable volumes or local cost exceeds both offers structurally; PARK if service is only a small distributor business.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: real buyers and service mechanism survive; a stronger nearby rival makes volumes and tender economics decisive.

investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: sulphur-fertiliser specialist builds pastillation near Tengiz/Atyrau for distributor sales.
buyer_market: Inland China/Central Asia and proposed South Asia/Turkey distributors; purchases unconfirmed.
why_now: UNKNOWN: a recent premium/demand trigger; raw sulphur availability is not the trigger.
strongest_realistic_alternative: Operating Sohar sulphur-bentonite producer with Gulf export access; China/other inland supply could be stronger for Xinjiang.
deciding_location_factor: Delivered qualified product margin after sulphur opportunity cost and freight.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: western Kazakh sulphur is a feed lead; only an inland freight advantage could offset Gulf shipping and established distribution.
scale_view: FACT: Sohar states 60 kt/yr plant (S05), proving industrial scale; reachable Kazakh-project sales UNKNOWN.
physical_constraint_view: Suitable bentonite, sulphur contract, melting/pastillation utilities and registrations UNKNOWN.
captured_status: An operating foreign incumbent exists; no evidence that all inland buyer demand is captured.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: formulated-fertiliser premium minus sulphur, bentonite, conversion and delivery; sulphur is not free.
cheapest_kill_test: Does one inland distributor netback beat Sohar supply at viable volume?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S05 describes operating sulphur-bentonite production at Sohar; it contradicts treating generic sulphur endowment as differentiation.
key_unknown: Whether inland landed advantage and distributor scale exist.
next_test_if_uwt: 45-min desk/quote test: same-grade, same-incoterm offers for one Xinjiang or Central Asian distributor from Atyrau and Sohar; include full feedstock price, registration and annual volume.
pass_condition_if_uwt: Identifiable inland purchases support minimum pastillation scale with a positive margin and a durable landed-cost edge.
kill_or_park_condition_if_uwt: FAIL if every reachable target is cheaper from incumbent supply at viable quality; PARK if only scattered small orders or a temporary premium remain.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: the inland variant is testable cheaply and is not disproven by a seaborne rival; preserve UWT rather than discard the whole market.

investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: fertiliser strategic co-funds sulphur-enriched MAP/NPK addition at Kazphosphate in Zhambyl.
buyer_market: Distributors in Central Asia/China/South Asia/Turkey; incremental product-specific demand unestablished.
why_now: FACT: sulphur-containing phosphate product already listed; a fresh capacity/product trigger is unestablished.
strongest_realistic_alternative: Kazphosphate's existing sulfoammophos line or brownfield expansion; OCP/Russian/Gulf imports secondary.
deciding_location_factor: Incremental product premium and low-cost integration on an available host line.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: integration is real at the incumbent; a new investor does not acquire that advantage without a differentiated grade/order.
scale_view: Existing fertiliser distribution demonstrates market access, not incremental volume for this addition.
physical_constraint_view: Actual expansion site, ammonia/acid allocation and utilities unconfirmed.
captured_status: FACT: S06 currently offers sulfoammophos; this captures the basic product capability, not necessarily all expansions.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: blend/formulation premium and brownfield savings; no incremental margin shown.
cheapest_kill_test: Does the supposed new product/capacity gap extend beyond incumbent supply?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S06 lists Karatau sulfoammophos for order; S07 describes an integrated phosphate/fertiliser operation.
key_unknown: An incremental grade/order and host-approved partner-funded asset.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: PARK for weak incremental differentiation over an existing integrated producer; existing output alone is not proof every future opening is closed. Reopen on a specific host expansion and buyer need.

opportunity_name: Purified phosphoric acid and ferric-phosphate precursor
investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: cathode-materials/chemical strategic builds Karatau-feed acid purification plus ferric-phosphate line in Zhambyl/Jibek Joly.
buyer_market: Non-China LFP/LMFP cathode makers or overseas plants; no qualified offtake.
why_now: Supply-diversification hypothesis; national processing ambition does not establish an accessible premium.
strongest_realistic_alternative: OCP/EMAPHOS Moroccan purified acid, or existing qualified Chinese-origin supply where permitted.
deciding_location_factor: Impurity removal yield/cost, buyer qualification and delivered precursor economics.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: phosphate integration could save intermediates/logistics; OCP already has purification/customer capability. No Kazakh advantage established.
scale_view: Export-led industrial opportunity plausible; addressable qualified tonnes and minimum line scale UNKNOWN.
physical_constraint_view: Representative ore assays, reagent/water balance, waste disposal and site utilities unverified.
captured_status: FACT: Kazphosphate has integrated feed operations; no evidence of an open battery-grade line or committed rival capture of this slot.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: battery-grade purity/precursor margin after purification losses and freight.
cheapest_kill_test: Can actual Karatau feed meet buyer battery specifications at a competitive yield/cost?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S07 confirms phosphate chain; S08 documents the established EMAPHOS PPA platform and planned LFP development. Neither proves Karatau battery qualification.
key_unknown: Ore impurity cost curve versus an actual cathode specification.
next_test_if_uwt: 60-min document test: obtain existing Karatau assay/purification reports and one cathode impurity specification; estimate reagent/yield bands and compare landed OCP PPA plus conversion.
pass_condition_if_uwt: Existing testwork supports required impurities and a viable yield/cost range, with buyer trial interest and accessible feed.
kill_or_park_condition_if_uwt: FAIL if critical impurities cannot be removed economically or buyer rules exclude the output; PARK if qualification timing misses the commercial window.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: technically and economically falsifiable; resource ownership is not enough for PASS, but impurity risk is not evidence of failure.

investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: battery-materials strategic takes equity/offtake in TAZA HPMSM expansion at Aksu/Pavlodar.
buyer_market: Non-China NMC/LMFP/LMR cathode/precursor makers; expansion orders unconfirmed.
why_now: FACT: IMnI describes operating certified HPMSM and an Aksu industrial-park expansion (S09).
strongest_realistic_alternative: Available existing TAZA capacity first, then Chinese HPMSM and non-China projects; best eligible landed supplier UNKNOWN.
deciding_location_factor: Qualified incremental demand, net margin and expansion utilisation.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: operating hydrometallurgy plus owned deposits reduces execution risk; it does not prove cheaper expansion than using existing capacity/imports.
scale_view: FACT: stated maximum existing capacity 22.5 kt/yr; actual output, spare capacity and qualified demand UNKNOWN.
physical_constraint_view: Existing operating route is evidenced; expansion acid, water, power, ore specification and connection capacity are not.
captured_status: FACT: existing plant is operating per IMnI; available expansion equity/offtake and need for new plant unestablished.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: full-cycle HPMSM margin with qualified non-China supply; no assumed sourcing premium.
cheapest_kill_test: Is expansion needed if existing capacity has spare output or no profitable new offtake?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S09 reports 2023 launch, 2024 certification, two acquired deposits and Aksu plans; certification is not customer-specific acceptance.
key_unknown: Incremental utilisation and buyer margin versus current capacity and eligible imports.
next_test_if_uwt: 45-min document test: latest TAZA output/utilisation, expansion scope/ownership and customer qualification/offtake; compare one expansion cost offer with existing-capacity and Chinese eligible delivered prices.
pass_condition_if_uwt: Incremental qualified demand exceeds usable existing capacity; expansion feed/utilities are accessible and the contract margin supports vendor capex.
kill_or_park_condition_if_uwt: FAIL if no incremental capex is required or proposed output cannot qualify/earn at best alternative price; PARK if demand arrives too late.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: a credible brownfield survivor, but the central expansion rather than spare-capacity decision is unresolved; UWT avoids rewarding operating-history disclosure alone.

investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: converter/Kazatomprom JV builds or revives natural-UF6 conversion at Ulba, Ust-Kamenogorsk.
buyer_market: Western/Asian utilities and enrichers, requiring approved routes and product.
why_now: Diversification is plausible; no current Ulba conversion mandate or transferable technology option established.
strongest_realistic_alternative: Contracting with/restarting/expanding licensed Cameco Port Hope, Orano France or US conversion capacity.
deciding_location_factor: Licensed technology, utility qualification and dependable conversion delivery over the investment cycle.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: uranium/HF availability helps inputs; incumbent brownfields already have converter know-how, licences and customers.
scale_view: Global conversion business is real (S10); demand available to a new Kazakh plant unquantified.
physical_constraint_view: UF6 licensing, packages/routes, technology rights, HF expansion and nuclear safeguards are major unresolved gates.
captured_status: No current Ulba UF6 commitment verified; existing UO2/fuel activities are different products.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: contracted conversion fee minus feed preparation, conversion and logistics cost.
cheapest_kill_test: Is a currently authorised converter willing to supply technology and qualifying contracts for Ulba?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S10 confirms Port Hope conversion business; S20 confirms Ulba HF listing, not UF6 process licence.
key_unknown: Current partner/licence and a timely investor-approved build case.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: PARK under the case deadline: a new nuclear conversion complex has several sequential licensing/technology gates and little demonstrated location edge over incumbent expansion. No technical impossibility claimed.

opportunity_name: High-purity gallium refining from Pavlodar feed
investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: semiconductor-materials refiner builds 6N/7N unit on Pavlodar gallium feed.
buyer_market: Non-China GaAs/GaN wafer/epitaxy supply chains; buyer-approved grades and terms needed.
why_now: FACT: ERG-Mitsubishi long-term supply contract and Q3 2026 production target (S11); actual commissioning not verified.
strongest_realistic_alternative: Shipping ERG feed for Japanese customer-linked refining; O.S. Tech is a demonstrated high-purity supplier, not proven ERG counterparty.
deciding_location_factor: Access to suitable uncommitted feed and qualification/purification spread, not bulk freight.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: co-location may assist process control; at only tonnes of high-value metal it need not outweigh established Japanese refining/customer links.
scale_view: FACT: ERG plans 15 t/yr. Standalone strategic ticket and refining margin may be small; no price extrapolation.
physical_constraint_view: Feed grade/impurities, clean refining technology, yield and site allocation UNKNOWN.
captured_status: FACT: Mitsubishi offtake signed. Scope/purity and exclusivity unknown; cannot infer 6N refining is already captured.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: refining fee or purity premium net of feed transfer price, losses and qualification.
cheapest_kill_test: Is any appropriate Pavlodar feed available for LOCAL high-purity refining under the existing contract?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S11 ties output to Mitsubishi and calls metal high-purity without a numeric grade; S35 offers 6.5N/7N in Japan.
key_unknown: Contract/purity boundary and a genuinely open refining slot.
next_test_if_uwt: 45-min document test: ERG/Mitsubishi product specification and contractual processing rights; compare refining in Pavlodar versus a Japanese toll-refining quote for one qualified buyer.
pass_condition_if_uwt: Contract permits a local unit, feed needs incremental refining and buyer-supported net spread pays for the proposed unit.
kill_or_park_condition_if_uwt: FAIL if feed is exclusively committed in a way that excludes local refining or already meets final grade with no incremental process need; PARK if ticket/spread is immaterial.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: do not assume merchant 4N feed, Japanese routing or local availability; contract boundaries are the decisive cheap test.

opportunity_name: Gallium recovery in proposed East Hope refinery
investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: gallium specialist co-funds recovery circuit within East Hope's proposed refinery design.
buyer_market: Gallium refiners/material buyers; product and ownership rights undefined.
why_now: FACT: May 2026 official meeting still discusses East Hope complex, feed and energy infrastructure (S12).
strongest_realistic_alternative: Recovery at an operating alumina refinery, including ERG Pavlodar; other bauxite-refinery circuits need assay comparison.
deciding_location_factor: Host refinery execution, gallium-bearing feed concentration and recoverable circuit economics.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: design-stage integration may save retrofit cost; proposed location has no demonstrated assay/access edge over operating hosts.
scale_view: Potential tonnes cannot be inferred from headline alumina investment; no established gallium mass balance.
physical_constraint_view: Base refinery energy/raw-material provision still discussed; gallium recovery feed/process rights absent.
captured_status: Announced/development-stage host; no evidence the gallium circuit is available, financed or captured.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: by-product recovery margin after incremental circuit cost.
cheapest_kill_test: Is a sponsor-approved recovery scope on assayed feed tied to a bankable refinery schedule?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S12 describes proposed Kostanay complex and unresolved infrastructure discussions; S11 identifies a nearer-term competing recovery host.
key_unknown: Host schedule, feed assay and investable rights.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: PARK for distant nested-project timing and multiple host dependencies; this is not a FAIL for an unverified circuit. Reopen on refinery FID and explicit recovery-partner request.

opportunity_name: Tungsten-carbide powder from proposed Kazakh APT
investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: hardmetal/powder strategic builds reduction/carburisation near proposed Karaganda APT.
buyer_market: Qualified non-China hardmetal/toolmakers; no reserved powder orders.
why_now: FACT: Cove/Tau-Ken definitive agreements and Kazakh APT study (S13); finance letters are not funded construction.
strongest_realistic_alternative: Processing transported APT in Wolfram's Austrian integrated virgin/recycling chain; Vietnam/Korea also candidates.
deciding_location_factor: Accessible APT, powder consistency/qualification and conversion cost versus established refiners.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: co-location could avoid intermediate handling; high-value APT can travel and incumbent powder know-how may dominate.
scale_view: Large proposed upstream scale; cannot translate total tungsten resource/output into uncommitted powder demand.
physical_constraint_view: Hydrogen/reducing gas, carbon, power, quality control and process site unconfirmed.
captured_status: FACT: Cove controls output marketing and 70% JV; study includes APT and other compounds. Carbide inclusion and third-party access UNKNOWN.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: powder conversion margin from secured APT plus qualified customer contracts.
cheapest_kill_test: Does upstream sponsor reserve carbide internally or allow a partner/feed allocation?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S13 expressly includes APT/other compounds and sole marketing responsibility; S14 demonstrates integrated APT-to-carbide plus recycled feed in Austria.
key_unknown: Exact downstream scope and authorised APT allocation.
next_test_if_uwt: 60-min document test: latest Cove DFS flowsheet/marketing mandate and partner procurement; identify whether carbide is in scope, then compare one authorised local powder case with Austria toll conversion.
pass_condition_if_uwt: Separate investable carbide scope and feed allocation confirmed, with qualifying buyer and credible cost/quality parity or advantage.
kill_or_park_condition_if_uwt: FAIL if the whole carbide scope/feed is closed to the proposed entry; PARK if APT timing or qualification defers the decision beyond a meaningful window.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: neither announce a free downstream slot nor declare capture from broad compounds wording; the boundary is testable.

investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: hardmetal-tool strategic builds carbide-button/drill-tool manufacture in Karaganda/Saryarka after local powder development.
buyer_market: Regional mines paying for qualified tool life and drilling performance.
why_now: Source thesis depends on future APT/powder rather than an evidenced new tooling procurement gap.
strongest_realistic_alternative: Continued qualified Sandvik/other OEM tool supply with local service, not merely a distant factory.
deciding_location_factor: Cost per drilled metre, lifetime qualification and OEM sales/service access.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: local tungsten proximity does not establish superior finished-tool performance or overcome established service channels.
scale_view: Regional mining is substantial, but no accessible tool-volume base or minimum efficient line evidenced.
physical_constraint_view: Powder/binder/press-sinter capability, design IP and mine trials would have to precede scale-up.
captured_status: FACT: Sandvik has a Kazakh service presence (S37); no evidence every tool segment is closed.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: tool gross margin and replacement/service sales at proven performance.
cheapest_kill_test: Does a mine have a product-specific unmet tool requirement versus incumbent service?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S13 puts upstream at DFS stage; S37 lists Ust-Kamenogorsk sales/service; S14 illustrates established powder capability abroad.
key_unknown: Performance-qualified order sufficient for a manufacturing line.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: PARK for weak location differentiation and sequential upstream/tool-qualification dependencies in the submitted later-stage thesis. Importing powder would change the source thesis, not validate it.

opportunity_name: UKTMP-linked titanium slab and billet melting
investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: aerospace/forging strategic co-invests in cold-hearth slab/billet melting near UKTMP, Ust-Kamenogorsk.
buyer_market: Aerospace forgers/engine and airframe supply chains; new-melt-route approvals required.
why_now: FACT: historical UKTMP slab capability (S15) and current ingot/alloy sales/expansion discussions (S16) are evidenced.
strongest_realistic_alternative: Using/expanding UKTMP's existing qualified melt assets or existing overseas aerospace melt supply.
deciding_location_factor: Incremental approved melt capability, feed/scrap allocation and conversion yield.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: established sponge chain and customer channels help; an existing slab catalogue makes the incremental cold-hearth gap critical.
scale_view: Aerospace export chain demonstrated; bottleneck and contracted incremental melt tonnes UNKNOWN.
physical_constraint_view: Power, cold-hearth process, scrap traceability/contamination controls and product-specific approval unresolved.
captured_status: FACT: historical slab production and current ingot/alloy activity evidenced; current slab utilisation and cold-hearth access not established.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: melt conversion fees, quality/yield premium and usable scrap recovery.
cheapest_kill_test: Is cold-hearth capacity rather than sponge or demand the actual bottleneck?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S15 records 2014 first electron-beam slab and 2016 reporting; S16 reports 2026 ingot/alloy growth, not a new partner slot.
key_unknown: Specific melt-route gap with buyer and host support.
next_test_if_uwt: 45-min document test: UKTMP equipment/capacity and downstream expansion plans plus one forger specification; map sponge, melting and approved product bottlenecks and feed/scrap availability.
pass_condition_if_uwt: Buyer identifies an incremental cold-hearth-qualified requirement, UKTMP offers feed/site and quoted conversion economics beat current supply.
kill_or_park_condition_if_uwt: FAIL if existing approved spare capacity fully serves the proposed orders or feed allocation excludes entry; PARK if only general aerospace growth supports demand.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: existing output weakens a missing-capability story but cannot kill a distinct process expansion; retain a narrow bottleneck test.

investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: AM-materials strategic builds titanium-alloy atomisation near UKTMP.
buyer_market: Export aerospace/medical/defence AM users needing specific powder sizes/chemistry; qualification and volume unconfirmed.
why_now: Sponge-expansion linkage is the source trigger; no specific powder shortage verified.
strongest_realistic_alternative: Existing Hoganas/other qualified AM powder production near customers; final best alternative UNKNOWN.
deciding_location_factor: Accepted powder yield/specification and delivered qualified cost, rather than sponge ownership alone.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: metal/feed competence is relevant; alloy preparation, atomisation and powder approval are distinct from sponge/slab certification.
scale_view: High-value export niche plausible; enough recurring accepted powder tonnes for a line UNKNOWN.
physical_constraint_view: Feed preparation, atomisation gas, oxygen control, recycling yield and traceability unverified.
captured_status: No Kazakh AM atomisation project captured status established; UKTMP general products do not certify this powder route.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: qualified powder premium after alloy feed, gas, classification loss and trial costs.
cheapest_kill_test: Will a buyer approve this exact feed/process route at an economic powder yield?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S15 records historical metal/slab operations; S17 demonstrates competing AM powder products. Neither qualifies a Kazakh powder route.
key_unknown: Buyer acceptance and yield-based cost versus incumbent powder.
next_test_if_uwt: 60-min specification test: one AM buyer's chemistry/size/traceability requirements against a vendor atomisation route using UKTMP feed; compare accepted yield and delivered quote with incumbent supply.
pass_condition_if_uwt: Vendor and buyer accept route for trials, reachable annual orders meet economic line scale, and quality-adjusted cost is competitive.
kill_or_park_condition_if_uwt: FAIL if route cannot meet mandatory impurity/traceability requirements economically; PARK if only research-scale demand or a long speculative qualification programme remains.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: credible adjacent know-how hypothesis with a concrete test; do not transfer aerospace sponge qualifications to powder.

investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: precision-alloy roller funds CuBe rolling/heat-treatment JV at or near Ulba.
buyer_market: Connector/spring, electronics and specialist industrial buyers; prospective, not committed.
why_now: Existing feed capability is real; recent buyer diversification/capacity trigger UNKNOWN.
strongest_realistic_alternative: Materion US/European strip supply and Ulba's existing Chinese rolling venture; NGK another candidate.
deciding_location_factor: Qualified strip tolerances/temper, conversion yield and eligible supply security.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: Ulba Be-alloy feed/know-how could help; moving rolling away from existing customer-linked plants needs a buyer-valued reason.
scale_view: Export specialist market plausible; product-specific accessible volumes not quantified.
physical_constraint_view: Be exposure controls, precision mills/heat treatment, feed contracts and product approval unresolved.
captured_status: FACT: Ulba history records 2007 Yingtan rolled-products JV; no evidence this bars a distinct Kazakh line.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: precision strip margin plus supply-security value net of rolling/safety cost.
cheapest_kill_test: Is there a buyer-valued qualified-strip gap beyond existing Ulba-linked and Western supply?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S18 documents Be-alloy chain; S19 records Chinese rolled-products venture; S34 confirms Materion strip production in US/Europe.
key_unknown: A distinct customer specification/origin need and available Ulba feed/partner slot.
next_test_if_uwt: 45-min document test: Ulba/Yingtan current grades and rights versus one target connector strip specification and origin requirement; compare local vendor conversion quote with Materion/NGK supply.
pass_condition_if_uwt: Specific unmet specification or sourcing constraint, accessible feed/JV and competitive qualified strip economics.
kill_or_park_condition_if_uwt: FAIL if existing contracts/rights exclude feed or proposed buyers have no eligible unserved requirement at viable volume; PARK if only undifferentiated strip substitution remains.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: the prior rolling location is an important rival case, not proof all future rolling investments fail. Preserve UWT for a bounded buyer/feed test.

investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: capacitor-materials strategic funds powder/wire JV or expansion at Ulba.
buyer_market: Capacitor manufacturers; incremental grades/quantities unestablished.
why_now: FACT: capacitor powders and wire are already products; a new growth/qualification trigger not established.
strongest_realistic_alternative: Buy existing Ulba material or expand its established line; specialist incumbent powders abroad.
deciding_location_factor: Incremental capacitance/impurity specification and utilisation of existing capacity.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: existing capability lowers risk but is already commercially exploited; generic product localisation adds little investor-location differentiation.
scale_view: Specialist export scale plausible; no indication of an incremental line rather than existing production participation.
physical_constraint_view: Feed traceability, powders' exact electrical performance and available utilities require scope-specific checks.
captured_status: FACT: S20 lists capacitor powders and tantalum wire; not proof ownership slots or every grade are closed.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: specialised powder/wire margin; no incremental grade premium established.
cheapest_kill_test: Is there any host-approved expansion/grade gap beyond the existing catalogue?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S20 explicitly lists both capacitor powders and wire as offered products.
key_unknown: Incremental asset/grade/order requiring foreign capital.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: PARK because the submitted proposition largely restates an existing business without a differentiated incremental capital need. Reopen on a host-approved expansion and buyer specification; do not FAIL for missing expansion data.

investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: specialty-metals strategic builds/partners in oxide-to-high-purity chromium metal at Aktobe.
buyer_market: Aerospace/turbine superalloy and master-alloy melters.
why_now: FACT: Sichuan Yinhe project in development; claimed general Russian-supply gap not independently established.
strongest_realistic_alternative: JFE Japan high-purity chrome/low-carbon superalloy feed and Western incumbents; not only Russia/China.
deciding_location_factor: Trace-impurity qualification and eligible delivered price; ore abundance is secondary.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: local chrome chemicals/feed may lower inputs, but degassing/refining know-how and approval dominate high-purity value.
scale_view: Superalloy market exists (S22); reachable qualified tonnes unestablished. S21 complex totals are not high-purity-metal tonnes.
physical_constraint_view: Oxide quality, reduction/degassing, Cr(VI) controls, water/waste and power require a specific line.
captured_status: FACT: S21 describes MoU/development, not financing or operating output; do not FAIL as captured.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: speciality metal margin after purification/qualification versus eligible existing chrome sources.
cheapest_kill_test: Does Yinhe cover the exact product/customer slot, and can another entry beat qualified non-Russian supply?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S21 describes a proposed mixed chrome complex; S22 markets Japanese high-purity superalloy chrome and a lower-cost alternative alloy.
key_unknown: Exact open product/partner scope and customer-specific qualification advantage.
next_test_if_uwt: 60-min document test: Yinhe latest permit/financing/product slate and partner structure; compare one Western melter specification and quote with JFE/Western supply and an Aktobe process offer.
pass_condition_if_uwt: Distinct open qualified product/entry is evidenced and credible Aktobe cost/quality or sourcing benefit survives incumbent comparison.
kill_or_park_condition_if_uwt: FAIL if financed/operating capacity exclusively covers the exact accessible slot or critical specs cannot be met; PARK if no buyer advantage beyond ore proximity.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: real competing project and a stronger eligible rival complicate the thesis, but neither establishes a fatal contradiction.

opportunity_name: Ferrochrome furnace with firmed renewable power
investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: ferroalloy strategic funds Kazakh furnace/retrofit with firmed renewable electricity for EU stainless buyers.
buyer_market: EU stainless mills/importers; a voluntary premium is not established in the submitted record.
why_now: FACT: CBAM definitive phase exists; the assumed electricity-emissions savings channel does not apply to current direct-only iron/steel calculation (S23).
strongest_realistic_alternative: Existing Kazakh furnace output under the same direct-emissions regime; eligible low-direct-emission incumbent ferrochrome.
deciding_location_factor: Recognised reduction in EU carbon charge from the funded electricity change.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: a renewable PPA reduces purchased-electricity emissions, not the furnace reductant/process emissions counted for Annex II goods.
scale_view: Large ferrochrome market cannot rescue an inapplicable return channel.
physical_constraint_view: Firm power/site economics still unknown; stop after the regulatory mechanism contradiction.
captured_status: Capture not decisive and not investigated beyond the killer.
economic_return_mechanism: Submitted mechanism: reduced delivered carbon-related costs through renewable power. Current CBAM does not monetise this indirect-emissions reduction.
cheapest_kill_test: Does switching electricity reduce the CBAM liability for the proposed ferrochrome product?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S23 (30 Sept 2026), definitive-phase/Annex II section, confirms iron and steel direct-only treatment. INFERENCE: holding direct process emissions constant, electricity-only change yields zero CBAM charge saving.
key_unknown: A separate voluntary premium, lower power cost or direct-process abatement could support a different thesis; none is established here.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: FAIL the submitted electricity-to-CBAM investment mechanism, not ferrochrome/decarbonisation generally. No hypothetical future scope extension or newly invented return channel is used to repair it. Human review should confirm this narrow thesis boundary.

opportunity_name: Balasausqandiq vanadium electrolyte supply and leasing
investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: flow-battery/electrolyte strategic builds conversion/leasing at Balasausqandiq near Shieli.
buyer_market: Regional IPPs/grid-storage owners using vanadium flow batteries; no contracted users identified.
why_now: FACT: mine feasibility work is advanced, but financing/FID targeted rather than evidenced funded (S24); storage growth is not vanadium demand.
strongest_realistic_alternative: Buy established electrolyte/vanadium products; storage buyers choose competing battery systems, including existing non-vanadium procurement.
deciding_location_factor: Contracted flow-battery adoption and electrolyte ownership/revenue terms, before ore proximity.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: avoiding transport of dilute electrolyte may help regional users; no local technology-specific buyer chain is established.
scale_view: S25 anchors 600 MWh of storage at Mirny, not a flow-battery/electrolyte order; cannot convert general BESS capacity to vanadium tonnes.
physical_constraint_view: Mine feed timing, acid chemistry/purity, plant utilities and leased-metal financing are sequential dependencies.
captured_status: No evidence local electrolyte slot is captured; mine financing interest is not electrolyte financing.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: conversion margin and leasing yield/retained-metal value under solvent counterparties.
cheapest_kill_test: Does any bankable regional storage procurement specify a flow battery and leaseable electrolyte?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S24 pp.5/8/10 separates proposed products and funding work; S25 provides a signed battery project without establishing any vanadium requirement.
key_unknown: Technology-specific contracted demand and financeable leasing terms.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: PARK for stacked demand-technology, mine-funding and leasing-counterparty dependencies under the deadline. Not a claim that lithium universally beats flow batteries. Reopen on a named flow-battery tender/offtake.

investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: anode-materials strategic funds Sarytogan-linked spheronisation/purification/coating in Karaganda/Pavlodar.
buyer_market: Non-China battery-cell/anode users; commercial approval/offtake unconfirmed.
why_now: FACT: project owner already incorporates purification, spheronisation and coating in staged plans (S26).
strongest_realistic_alternative: Sarytogan's own integrated stages versus transporting concentrate to established non-China processors; China where buyer rules permit.
deciding_location_factor: Saleable anode yield, qualification, secured power and rights to the downstream stage.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: high-grade feed/integration could help; published integrated scope means no free independent downstream gap can be assumed.
scale_view: S26 describes 50 kt/yr concentrate and smaller downstream stages; these are project plans, not qualified sales.
physical_constraint_view: Thermal power/carbon/connection, water, product yield and customer cycling tests unverified at commercial scale.
captured_status: Planned downstream scope already exists, but no evidence all strategic equity/offtake/processing rights are closed.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: qualified anode margin net of purification/coating energy, yields and freight.
cheapest_kill_test: Does testwork establish an economic anode route and is any downstream investment scope open?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S26 PFS stages explicitly include spherical and coated products; published plant sections contain differing thermal-capacity descriptions. Latest exchange documents not fully accessible.
key_unknown: Commercial anode yield/qualification and a non-duplicative authorised investment role.
next_test_if_uwt: 60-min document test: latest dated Sarytogan DFS/downstream testwork (including Sept/Oct 2026 filings) and stage ownership/offtake terms; reconcile yields, thermal capacity and power cost with buyer anode specifications.
pass_condition_if_uwt: Current tests support saleable yield/qualification path, an authorised strategic role remains, and landed economics survive eligible rival supply.
kill_or_park_condition_if_uwt: FAIL if representative testwork cannot meet necessary anode performance economically or all relevant rights are closed; PARK if downstream is deferred pending upstream development.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: preserve the real resource/processing thesis while preventing a false missing-downstream claim. Existing plans are not proof of funded capture.

investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: recycling strategic builds e-scrap collection/sampling/shredding tied to a Kazakh smelter.
buyer_market: Host smelter pays for prepared feed/metals; collection contracts provide material.
why_now: Waste-treatment need and host capacity are plausible; a new host acceptance/contracting trigger is not established.
strongest_realistic_alternative: Licensed collection plus direct export/tolling to established integrated recyclers such as Umicore, subject to legal routes.
deciding_location_factor: Host acceptance/payables, lawful feed volume and net recovered-metal settlement.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: shorter local handling may help; ordinary copper-smelting nameplate does not establish safe e-scrap acceptance/recovery.
scale_view: Reachable collected/assayed tonnes UNKNOWN; national e-waste generation would overstate accessible feed.
physical_constraint_view: Contaminant/halogen limits, sampling, emissions and cross-border PIC required where applicable.
captured_status: No verified Kazakh host contract; foreign specialised route exists but is not proof local entry is closed.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: collection/treatment fees plus payable-metal margin less preprocessing, losses, smelter charges and working capital.
cheapest_kill_test: Will one host accept and pay for actual preprocessed e-scrap at legal volumes?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S27 brings transboundary e-waste under PIC from 2025; S28 documents a specialised integrated recycling route. Neither confirms Kazzinc acceptance.
key_unknown: A technically accepting host and margin-bearing, legally collectible feed.
next_test_if_uwt: 45-min document test: one proposed host feed-acceptance/payables schedule against representative supplier assays and collection rights; verify domestic/cross-border permits and compare licensed export tolling netback.
pass_condition_if_uwt: Accepting host and lawful committed feed meet line scale with positive conservative settlement margin versus export/tolling.
kill_or_park_condition_if_uwt: FAIL if all proposed hosts reject the feed or no lawful collection/import route exists; PARK if accessible tonnes or payables support only marginal trading.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: preprocessing can be smaller than a new refinery and has a clear settlement test; regulatory controls constrain access but are not a blanket ban.

investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: precious-metals recycler funds spent-catalyst/autocatalyst PGM recovery at a Kazakh metals complex.
buyer_market: PGM-bearing catalyst owners and recovered-metal buyers; ordinary base-metal catalysts are not automatically PGM feed.
why_now: No current catalyst-owner gap/turnaround schedule establishes a fresh local recovery decision.
strongest_realistic_alternative: Ship or toll legally through specialised PGM recovery/refining such as Metalor/Umicore; regional aggregator alternative.
deciding_location_factor: PGM-bearing feed ownership/assay and recovery/settlement yield versus specialist tolling.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: collection proximity alone is weak for high-value metal; base-metal smelting is not proof of a complete PGM flowsheet.
scale_view: No identified PGM-bearing corpus; aggregating all spent catalysts would overstate market.
physical_constraint_view: Dedicated assay/sampling, PGM chemistry, permits, emissions and settlement working capital required.
captured_status: Specialist foreign recovery exists; no claim the Kazakh slot is captured.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: treatment charges plus metal payables/recovery margin net of feed acquisition and refining costs.
cheapest_kill_test: Is a recurring owned PGM-bearing feed corpus large enough for a dedicated recovery line?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S29 describes catalyst-specific assay/evaluation and recycling; S28 describes specialised integrated PGM processes, not automatic transfer from a base-metal smelter.
key_unknown: A contracted PGM inventory and suitable recovery host.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: PARK for weak demonstrated local-versus-tolling mechanism and disproportionate dedicated flowsheet/collection work for an undefined corpus. Reopen on a specific assayed catalyst-owner programme; no technical impossibility inferred.

investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: mining/reprocessing strategic acquires long-term tailings rights and funds a suitable plant; no asset/location specified.
buyer_market: Metal buyers/smelters depend on a recoverable product that is not yet defined.
why_now: FACT: 2026 MET relief exists; fiscal eligibility does not create assayed assets or available rights.
strongest_realistic_alternative: Process an accessible assayed incumbent tailings asset elsewhere, or leave low-grade liabilities untreated; strongest project cannot be named without a substrate.
deciding_location_factor: Recoverable grade/yield, title/liabilities and installed processing cost per payable metal unit.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: UNKNOWN: no specific Kazakh place/asset to compare; national accumulated waste is not accessible ore.
scale_view: No defined assay/tonnage basis; no responsible reachable-market calculation possible.
physical_constraint_view: Title, geotechnical stability, water, power, environmental liability and metallurgy are site-specific.
captured_status: Not established; no asset-specific acquisition or rights opening identified.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: recovered-metal netback minus reprocessing and inherited liabilities, with applicable tax reduction.
cheapest_kill_test: Is there a legally available assayed tailings asset underlying this platform?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S30 reports Article 783 coefficient 0.1 (tenfold MET reduction), not a universal exemption or 0.01; it does not identify an investment asset.
key_unknown: Asset identity, transferable rights and recoverable product.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: PARK an asset-unspecified platform under the deadline: constructing a new asset-level thesis would be discovery/repair, not this screen. Real tax relief prevents a false policy-based FAIL.

investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: copper processor builds merchant rod mill beside a proposed Abai/Balkhash smelter for export.
buyer_market: Turkey/Central Asia/EU wire and cable makers; contracted conversion demand absent.
why_now: More future cathode is not a rod-demand trigger; existing domestic rod capacity competes.
strongest_realistic_alternative: Existing Kazakhmys Kazkat rod capacity or brownfield expansion; Uzbek/Turkish mills close to customers.
deciding_location_factor: Conversion premium after cathode opportunity cost, utilisation and incremental export freight.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: local cathode can reduce one leg of freight; rod still ships to buyer and must beat the incumbent integrated line.
scale_view: FACT: S31 lists up to 50 kt/yr rod; spare capacity/exports unknown. Domestic gap cannot be presumed.
physical_constraint_view: New-smelter timing, cathode allocation, casting power/water and hot-metal route not verified.
captured_status: Existing rod capability confirmed; not proof all export demand is served or future mills are captured.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: rod conversion margin and genuine energy/logistics savings, not copper-price appreciation.
cheapest_kill_test: Can a new export mill beat existing rod capacity after full freight and feed transfer price?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S31 lists existing rod production; it also describes cathode-based refining/product chain. Cheap molten-feed savings are not established.
key_unknown: Large recurring export orders with sufficient conversion premium over the best delivered incumbent.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: PARK for weak demonstrated incremental economics and a future-smelter dependency against an existing integrated domestic alternative. Not FAIL merely because an incumbent exists. Reopen on contracted export premium and available feed.

opportunity_name: Copper magnet-wire production near new smelters
investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: electrical-materials strategic builds magnet-wire drawing/enamelling near Abai/Balkhash copper cluster; optional captive rod only.
buyer_market: Transformer/motor OEMs in Kazakhstan and export markets; product-specific qualification matters.
why_now: Future smelting is a feed lead, not demand. OEM requirements could support a distinct grade, presently unestablished.
strongest_realistic_alternative: Existing Kazakhmys Balkhash enamel-wire line plus qualified Turkish/Uzbek import supply; strongest offer depends on grade.
deciding_location_factor: OEM-accepted thermal/mechanical grade, delivery reliability and net conversion margin.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: feed integration and local OEM service may help a distinct grade; basic wire production is already present.
scale_view: FACT: S31 lists up to 12 kt/yr enamel wire; no spare capacity or addressable grade volume verified.
physical_constraint_view: Wire/enamel technology, rod/feed quality, power/water, solvent controls and OEM approval unresolved.
captured_status: FACT: existing medium/fine enamel-wire products listed; not proof all proposed grades or export customers are served.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: qualified enamel-wire conversion premium after drawing losses, enamel, energy and delivery.
cheapest_kill_test: Is an economically significant OEM specification/volume underserved after existing line capacity?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S31 lists copper/enamel wire and process/product ranges; source thesis cannot claim a blank domestic downstream slot.
key_unknown: A qualified grade/order gap and delivered-price advantage versus existing capacity/imports.
next_test_if_uwt: 45-min document test: one transformer/motor OEM's grade and annual demand against Kazakhmys current range/capacity and Turkish/Uzbek offers; confirm input route and project scope.
pass_condition_if_uwt: Unserved specification/volume meets viable line utilisation and buyer qualification/price supports competitive net conversion margin.
kill_or_park_condition_if_uwt: FAIL if incumbent qualified spare capacity covers all identified accessible orders with no advantage for a new line; PARK if only small custom batches or a speculative smelter-linked demand story remain.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: technical grade differentiation may preserve an opening even with an incumbent; retain UWT rather than assume either capture or a ready market.

investor_capital_decision: HYPOTHESIS: EAF steel strategic takes equity/offtake in ERG/SSGPO Rudny HBI development.
buyer_market: EU/Turkey EAF steelmakers seeking DRI/HBI quality and secure delivered iron units.
why_now: FACT: Sept 2026 ERG response reports indefinite pause; 2025 build contract is no longer a live timing anchor.
strongest_realistic_alternative: Operating/new Gulf HBI near gas and ports, or continue existing iron-unit procurement; strongest specific Gulf plant not resolved.
deciding_location_factor: Gas/DR-grade feed and delivered iron-unit cost, plus an available restart equity decision.
kazakhstan_vs_alternative: INFERENCE: ore/pellet integration helps; landlocked export freight and unconfirmed gas weaken the claimed advantage over gas/port locations.
scale_view: Historical plan 2 Mt/yr; S32 says capacity/cost may be revised. Not current reachable offtake.
physical_constraint_view: Firm gas terms, DR-grade pellet route, power/water and emissions/hydrogen economics remain unconfirmed.
captured_status: FACT: paused rather than captured. S32 says prior technology agreements expired and financing structure is deferred.
economic_return_mechanism: HYPOTHESIS: HBI margin and secure feed for strategic EAF buyer; hydrogen-ready does not mean hydrogen supplied or low actual emissions.
cheapest_kill_test: Is there an active, sponsor-approved equity/offtake opening on a funded restart schedule?
decisive_evidence: FACT: S33 establishes 2025 contract; S32 (25 Sept 2026), quoting ERG directly, reports no restart date, lapsed agreements and capital redirected to pellets.
key_unknown: A restart mandate and revised gas/financing/equity terms.
screening_rationale: JUDGMENT: PARK for an evidenced indefinite sponsor pause under the case deadline. Do not FAIL permanently: a foreign partner could in principle reopen capital allocation, but no such live mandate is established.
